D.  COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

There were no Committee Reports.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that ShotSpotter go live Wednesday, March 28th.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced that a Public Works block cleanup will be held on
Saturday, March 25, 2023.

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that a pet vaccination clinic will
be held on March 18; Wall That Heals will be held March 23​­26, 2023, with a parade on March 21st.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, announced that dialog with business owners will continue.

Councilmember Roa requested research on extending sidewalk dining.

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, spoke.
